decisions.title: MRCOG Population and Housing Data
decisions.description: Compares 2020 Census population with 2024 estimates for Albuquerque, Bernalillo County, other regional communities, and the four-county region, with historical charts tracking housing permits, housing growth, and housing type through 2024.
processing_notes: Reviewed the complete official page and its accessible data table.
Chart images were not separately archived because they reproduce maintained tabular data and are expected to change with updates.

decisions.title: MRCOG Employment Data
decisions.description: Compiles current county and regional labor-force, employment, unemployment, industry, wage, establishment, growth-rate, and location-quotient data from federal statistical programs, including detailed 2024 employment measures for the Albuquerque metropolitan economy.
processing_notes: Reviewed the complete official page and its accessible data tables.
Chart images were not separately archived because they reproduce maintained tabular data and are expected to change with updates.

decisions.title: MRCOG Income Data
decisions.description: Tracks annual per-capita personal income from 2004 through 2024 for Bernalillo and neighboring counties, New Mexico, and the United States, with long-run comparisons and source references to federal economic data.
processing_notes: Reviewed the complete official page and its accessible historical table.
Chart images were not separately archived because they reproduce maintained tabular data and are expected to change with updates.

decisions.title: MRCOG Commuting Data
decisions.description: Summarizes regional county-to-county worker flows, commute mode shares, travel times, and work-from-home changes using 2023 and 2024 Census sources, including the relationship between Bernalillo County and surrounding commuter counties.
processing_notes: Reviewed the complete official page and its accessible data tables.
Chart images were not separately archived because they reproduce maintained tabular data and are expected to change with updates.
